title: Exodus wallet vault
whyItMatters: Exodus stores an encrypted vault with the private keys for the person's coins. With the password it is the money; without it, it still proves what they owned.
source: Elastic detection-rules macOS wallet paths reference ~/Library/Application Support/Exodus - https://github.com/elastic/detection-rules/issues/6616
notes: Contains the encrypted exodus.wallet vault and timestamped backups. Unconfirmed (no Mac to test): macOS 27 may block this folder with com.apple.macl; no file is opened.
